description: Defines image-role requirements for household category index entries without storing image binaries in Git.

requiredRoles.description: Commerce/product images, preferably China mainland ecommerce sources.
Real household scene images or user-confirmed in-home crops.

recommendedRoles.description: Close-up images for fine-grained cues such as ports, knobs, labels, texture, package front text.
Different brands, form factors, colors, old/new styles or common model families.
